t: The list, and which one he picked out
a: تُنْكَحُ الْمَرْأَةُ لأَرْبَعٍ لِمَالِهَا وَلِحَسَبِهَا وَجَمَالِهَا وَلِدِينِهَا، فَاظْفَرْ بِذَاتِ الدِّينِ
p: Tunkaḥu-l-marʾatu li-arbaʿ: li-mālihā wa li-ḥasabihā wa jamālihā wa li-dīnihā. Fa-ẓfar bi-dhāti-d-dīn
m: A woman is married for four things: her wealth, her family standing, her beauty, and her religion. So win the one with religion.
